contexts.text: Speckled and spotted are from black and white. Black = evil; in particular, what is man's own... White = truth, ... in the opposite, man's own righteousness or merit... Thus speckled good with which evil is mixed.
Thus speckled, or that which is marked and divided up into points of black and white, = good with which evil is mixed. AC 3995. AC 4006. AC 4020. AC 4079.
Speckled (in the Hebrew) is expressed by a word which means a herdman. Illustrated.
